set.body: A globally rank-deficient weighted group design currently returns Right(GroupResult) with all-NaN coefficients. This behavior is explicitly covered by the old GroupInferenceSuite, so changing it requires deliberate contract evolution rather than calling it an accidental regression. It conflicts with the desired total typed model/fitting boundary and cannot provide a good UI recovery path. Owner: ScalaFIM group. Acceptance: reject globally invalid designs before voxel loops; represent any voxel-specific failure with identified typed status/reasons rather than anonymous NaNs; retain valid sample results and explicit availability; version compatibility as needed; JVM+JS. Evidence: audit bd-01M20MJY5QG8F7X2ZQENTTWPD7.
set.title: Group weighted fits: distinguish numerical failure from successful maps
